outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: 269 patients with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) II-III who wanted to conceive
finding: LEEP is safer for future pregnancies compared to CKC, with lower rates of PPROM, preterm delivery, and low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: The loop electrosurgical excision procedure (LEEP) was associated with lower rates of preterm premature rupture of membranes, preterm delivery, and low birth weight infants compared to cold-knife conization (CKC).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was recorded, but specific values not provided
